metadata.label: Monochrome
metadata.coverage: Cassini I/F observations projected onto the released shape. Bounded photometric normalization reduces broad acquired shading; true cast shadows and unreliable geometry are withheld. Gray grid marks unobserved areas.

metadata.label: False color
metadata.coverage: Cassini IR3, GRN, UV3 filters displayed as red, green and blue; observed illumination and common coverage only.

celestial.sunSource: Vendored JPL satellite orbit and a source-owned approximate IAU pole/spin presentation; source images use the independent PDS model camera geometry.

controls.label: Monochrome

controls.label: Elevation
controls.notes: Radial height above a 15.1 km reference sphere from the Cassini shape model. This includes the broad irregular shape; it is not height above a gravity-defined geoid. Fixed relief lighting shows slopes; shape uncertainties vary by region.
